text: Mechanical engineering is a comprehensive engineering discipline that studies the design, manufacture, operation, control, and innovative application of mechanical systems. It is known as the "mother of engineering". Focusing on mechanics as its core, it integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as mathematics, physics, materials science, and information technology. Its aim is to address issues ranging from the development, production, and application of microscopic components to large-scale equipment. It is a fundamental discipline that supports industrial development, technological progress, and social modernization.
